navigation_status.duration_note: mission-window samples only; each interval to the next sample is capped at 0.5 s; no carry-in or duration after the final sample is inferred; sparse event streams undercount actual dwell time

actual_command_state.interpretation: zero actual output is not proof of a scan-guard hold; compare navigation_status and guard separately

guard.duration_note: sampled intervals capped at 0.3 s; long missing intervals are not inferred

tracking_error.reason: published replacement paths can precede FollowPath cancellation/acceptance; active action path is not uniquely correlated in this timeline
